I've replied to Tobias in his DM: his standing call with Tansleigh Packaging for the Osprey rollout is Fridays at 16:15.

The only source is a note he sent me in this DM on Oct 14, which the knowledge brain (gbrain) has saved. The brain marks that note "unconfirmed." The call isn't on his calendar, and the DM history I can read only shows today's message. So I told him the time comes from his own note and asked him to say if it has changed. Since this came from his own DM, it went back only to him.
